objective: 真实任务(EVOLUTION-BENCH-001前置侦察): 10个公开B2B目录的可达性与数据入口探测, 为数据采集选型提供事实

shards.instructions: for u in www.kompass.com www.tradeindia.com www.exportersindia.com; do echo "== $u"; curl -sL -m 15 -o /dev/null -w 'home=%{http_code} t=%{time_total}s\n' -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/126.0 Safari/537.36' https://$u/; curl -s -m 10 -o /dev/null -w 'robots=%{http_code}\n' -A 'Mozilla/5.0' https://$u/robots.txt; done

for u in www.made-in-china.com goldsupplier.com tradekey.com; do echo "== $u"; curl -sL -m 15 -o /dev/null -w 'home=%{http_code} t=%{time_total}s\n' -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/126.0 Safari/537.36' https://$u/; curl -s -m 10 -o /dev/null -w 'robots=%{http_code}\n' -A 'Mozilla/5.0' https://$u/robots.txt; done

echo '== europages search页可索引性'; curl -sL -m 20 -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/126.0 Safari/537.36' 'https://www.europages.co.uk/companies.html' | head -c 400 | tr -d '\0'; echo; curl -sL -m 20 -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/126.0 Safari/537.36' 'https://www.europages.co.uk/companies.html' -o /tmp/ep.html -w 'bytes=%{size_download} code=%{http_code}\n'; grep -c -o 'CompanyCard' /tmp/ep.html 2>/dev/null || echo 'CompanyCard=0'; grep -c -o 'href="/company' /tmp/ep.html 2>/dev/null || true
shards.expected_output: europages列表页是否直出公司卡片(静态可采性)

shards.instructions: echo '== alibaba trade搜索静态性'; curl -sL -m 25 -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/126.0 Safari/537.36' 'https://www.alibaba.com/trade/search?SearchText=valves' -o /tmp/al.html -w 'bytes=%{size_download} code=%{http_code} final=%{url_effective}\n'; grep -c -o 'organic-list' /tmp/al.html 2>/dev/null || echo organic=0; grep -c -o 'caption' /tmp/al.html 2>/dev/null || true; head -c 300 /tmp/al.html
